summary: Hesai Group furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-17 attaching its 2026 interim report for the six months ended June 30, 2026, filed to satisfy Hong Kong Listing Rule 13.48(1) as a Hong Kong-listed foreign private issuer. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, adviser, or structural/regulatory term is disclosed; the filing is a routine semi-annual financial reporting obligation (the US equivalent of a Form 6-K furnishing interim results). No special-situation or deal-related risk-arb angle applies; watch only ordinary operating and disclosure developments.
